assessment.shape: The selected body has a broad flattened head, near-terminal mouth, five gill slits, two dorsal fins and a longer upper tail lobe. The retained head/body proportions are unmeasured. Longitudinal ridges are too subdued for detailed diagnostic anatomy; no internal filtering screens are built.
assessment.surface: The initial plain-white failure was caused by an obsolete material extension. Conversion restored the creator’s dark surface and pale spotting. Spot sizes and spacing are more uniform than the authentic reference; transverse bars, exact ridge relief and skin microstructure remain incomplete.
assessment.motion: Same body and UV atlas inspected through two lateral-undulation phases and three axes. The integrated centerline retains station lengths; no physiological or fluid-dynamic validation follows from that numerical property. Fin articulation, intermittent glide and active filtration are incomplete.
changes: Converted unsupported specular/glossiness source materials to current PBR without remeshing or replacing UVs.
Added continuous lateral posterior swimming on the retained artist surface.
Added source-linked anatomy and an authentic Daniel Benák reference, with exact delivered/source-derivative checksums.
Kept feeding unavailable rather than labelling a swim loop as filtration.
remaining: Subdued longitudinal ridges and overly regular spotting require further surface work.
No morphometric fit, species-specific flow solver or measured tailbeat trajectory.
Mouth/gill/filter coupling and glide phases are not implemented.

originalAccess.scope: Original-resolution URL derived from the source photo URL; original retrieval timed out. The actual downloaded source is the openly licensed large derivative at downloadUrl; downloadSha256 covers that exact derivative, not inaccessible original-resolution bytes.

model.delivery: Bundled GLB; one local viewer and same retained textured mesh through supported actions
model.biology: Artist interpretation; species identity, surface and unmeasured motion reviewed against cited sources but not independently validated.
model.changes: The retained textured body and fins follow a continuous laterally bending posterior centerline. The longitudinal centerline is integrated from angular stations to avoid stretching it by additive displacement. This is an uncalibrated active-swimming illustration; no measured trajectory, passive descent, filtration or fluid solver is claimed. The obsolete specular/glossiness material extension was converted to supported glTF PBR materials. Source positions, UVs, weights, joints and clip channels were retained; source and delivered checksums differ and are separately recorded.
